findings.detail: Noramco's investment terms contain a SOFR basis spread of 8.38% and a separate 0.38% PIK leg; treating 0.38% as the basis spread would be a field extraction error.

rationale: The current debt schedule localizes the one-of-eight basis-spread format issue to Noramco. The raw investment cell states 'SOFR + 8.38 %, 1.00 % Floor, 0.38 % PIK', so the basis spread is 8.38% while 0.38% is explicitly the PIK leg. This supports a real extraction/localization defect rather than a source-supported basis spread of 0.38%.
